game_concept: A puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry, a glassy black quarry: the forge smith must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Sorter: Sort falling fire gems into bins labelled int, float, str and bool before they hit the ground.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Obsidian Quarry: a glassy black quarry
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
player_objective: Read value for station 1, then display the same value without changing it. Test dataset 1: {'value': -1}; {'value': 3}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Type Sorter' (Week 2 slot 1), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Obsidian Quarry'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Reach the ember furnace using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
source_win_condition: The ember furnace reached with actions_used <= 19.
source_lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the ember furnace is reached, or lives reach 0.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
